mapper.select: SELECT service_id, display_name, status FROM service_principal WHERE credential_hash = #{credentialHash}
SELECT permission_id, service_id, operation, max_amount, status FROM service_permission WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND operation = #{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_authorization_log ( service_id, operation, decision, deny_reason, idempotency_key, amount, sender_account_no, trace_id, request_path ) VALUES ( #{serviceId}, #{operation}, #{decision}, #{denyReason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{amount}, #{senderAccountNo}, #{traceId}, #{requestPath} )
